Keshar Singh Chauhan
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & Others 
--Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. D.S. Mehta, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Amarendra Pratap Singh, learned 
Additional Advocate General with Mr. B.S. 
Parihar, learned Additional CSC and Mr. M.S. 
Bisht, learned Standing Counsel for the State.
3. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned Standing 
Counsel for the Union of India.
4. Learned State Counsel has placed on 
record instructions received from Additional 
Secretary Uttarakhand Administration dated 
17.06.2026; the stand taken therein is that the 
State Government is in the process of finalizing 
the service rules laying down the procedure for 
selection to the post of Director (Prosecution). It 
is stated that as soon as the rules are finalized 
further action shall be taken in the matter.
5. In view of the stand taken, the hearing of 
the writ petition is deferred for six weeks.
6. List immediately after six weeks. 7. Meanwhile, the progress made in respect 
of finalization of the rules shall be brought on 
record by means of written instructions. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.)(Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
